# .github

- reviewdog.yaml builds sisakulint itself on every PR and runs `sisakulint --format sarif --exclude actions` (from `.reviewdog.yml`) over the repository. `--exclude actions` keeps the intentionally vulnerable examples and test data under `actions/` out of the review. Findings on the lines that the PR changes are posted as review comments. Without `--online`, a finding that needs a fact from GitHub (for example, whether a pinned commit belongs to the action repository) is reported as conditional.
- CI.yaml runs a Verify job (45 minutes) that enforces gofmt, runs `go test -timeout 30m ./...`, and checks reachable vulnerabilities with govulncheck. A failure of any of the three fails the job. Keep the same checks green locally before committing.
- upstream-drift.yaml runs every week and on `workflow_dispatch`. The workflow runs the tests that compare the data taken from other projects (release tables of actions, GitHub-hosted runner labels, quoted source texts) with those projects, with `ACTIONS_UPSTREAM=1` and the workflow token.
- Releases fire from release.yml on a v*.*.* tag push, running goreleaser and a Homebrew tap update that needs the TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN PAT. goreleaser builds `./cmd/sisakulint`, and `go build` takes the version from the tag. The two tap targets differ: .goreleaser.yml writes the formula to gh-intel/homebrew-sisakulint, and the after_release job of release.yml clones and pushes ultra-supara/homebrew-sisakulint.
- The v1 linter reads a configuration file only when `--config` names the file. The repository has no configuration file.
